name: Physiology
overview: Scripture reveals that human physiology is intricately designed by God, who has clothed us with skin, flesh, bones, and sinews, demonstrating His careful and intentional creation (Job 10:11). The psalmist praises God's marvelous workmanship, acknowledging that our very substance and members were known and fashioned by God even before birth (Psalms 139:14-16). Proverbs highlights the connection between the heart and physical life, teaching that a sound heart sustains the flesh, while envy harms the bones (Proverbs 14:30). Furthermore, Ephesians uses the metaphor of the body to illustrate the unity and growth of the church, emphasizing the importance of every part working together for edification in love (Ephesians 4:16). Together, these verses affirm that our physical being is both a testament to God's creative power and a picture of spiritual truth.
